rules.title: Distinct Primary Focal Point
rules.requirement: The main hero headline must have at least 2.5x font size and 300 weight difference compared to surrounding body text.
rules.implementation: Hero headline uses --font-size-5xl (clamp 44px-64px), font-weight 800, leading 1.1, and high contrast against background.

rules.title: Category Badges as Anchors
rules.requirement: Each content section must begin with a compact, uppercase pill badge before the H2 to orient the reader.
rules.implementation: Applied .badge-pill with 12px uppercase semibold text, letter-spacing 0.08em, and subtle emerald tint.

rules.title: Modular Fluid Scale
rules.requirement: All typography must follow the defined modular scale without arbitrary font sizes.
rules.implementation: Utilized CSS variables --font-size-2xs through --font-size-5xl with responsive clamp() values.

rules.title: Modern System Font Stack
rules.requirement: Replace browser default serif with clean modern sans-serif typography featuring optimal line height.
rules.implementation: Inter / system sans stack, body text at 16px with 1.6 line height and comfortable 68ch max reading width.

rules.title: Strict 8pt Geometric Grid
rules.requirement: Margins, paddings, and grid gaps must map to multiples of 4px/8px.
rules.implementation: Used --space-1 through --space-24 throughout layout, cards, and navigation.

rules.title: WCAG AA/AAA Contrast Compliance
rules.requirement: Body text must maintain > 4.5:1 contrast, large headings > 3:1, and UI elements > 3:1.
rules.implementation: Text primary (#f8fafc) on canvas (#090d16) provides 16.5:1 ratio; secondary (#94a3b8) provides 5.8:1 ratio.

rules.title: Elevation Surface Tiers
rules.requirement: Use depth tiers (Canvas, Surface, Elevated Surface) with subtle translucent borders instead of harsh outlines.

rules.title: Centered Max-Width Container
rules.requirement: Content must be constrained to a 1200px max-width container with responsive horizontal padding.

rules.title: Responsive CSS Grid
rules.requirement: Multi-item groups (speakers, pricing, stats, schedule) must transform into flexible multi-column grids.
rules.implementation: Utilized grid-template-columns with auto-fit / auto-fill minmax(280px, 1fr) for adaptive column distribution.

rules.title: Zero Horizontal Overflow
rules.requirement: No component or container may cause horizontal viewport scrolling at any width between 320px and 2560px.
rules.implementation: Tested and validated with overflow-x: hidden on root, max-width: 100% on inner blocks.

rules.title: Mobile Touch Targets
rules.requirement: All clickable buttons and navigation links must meet the 44px x 44px minimum touch target size.
rules.implementation: Buttons and nav links styled with minimum height 44px and inline padding.

rules.title: Visible Focus States
rules.requirement: Keyboard navigation must show high-contrast, unambiguous focus rings on all interactive elements.
rules.implementation: :focus-visible styling with 2px solid emerald ring and 2px offset.

rules.title: Reduced Motion Respect
rules.requirement: Disable transitions and hover animations when users specify prefers-reduced-motion.
rules.implementation: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) disables transform animations and transitions.
